items.name: resize-handle
items.title: Resize Handle & Panel Reopen Tab
items.description: Shell Resize Handle (the 12px drag edge of a resizable panel: invisible at rest, stroke-strong on hover, info-primary while dragging or focused) and Panel Reopen Tab (20×56 tab flush with the canvas edge when a panel is closed; click reopens at the default width, drag pulls it out). Used by AppShell.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Shell App Shell: shared chrome for every urbanflow product (urbanflow, Flux). A top bar, then a canvas full-bleed behind a left panel, floating canvas tools (AppShellPin top-right / bottom-centre / bottom-right) and a right panel, 8px inset. The shell owns both panel widths: they open at the product defaults every session (left urbanflow 252 / Flux 360, right 359 / 300), resize by dragging their inner edge with no maximum, always keep a 24px gap (growing one squeezes the other), close when dragged to 0 with a reopen tab on that edge, and are never saved. Canvas tools hide when there isn't room. Products fill the slots; modes and tools go on the canvas, never as tabs in the top bar.

items.name: top-navigation
items.title: Top Navigation
items.description: Shell Top Navigation: 44px dark bar with the product logo and the urbanflow TopNav project bar (project switcher menu, open proposal and its status, notifications, collaborators, credits). product="flux" hides notifications and collaborators.

items.name: proposal-badge
items.title: Proposal Badge
items.description: Shell Proposal Badge and Proposal Title: proposal status (Draft, Behind main, In review, Changes suggested, Ready for merge, Merged, Closed shown as Archived) and the proposal name with its badges on the dark top bar.

items.name: utilities-toolbar
items.title: Utilities Toolbar
items.description: Shell Utilities Toolbar: floating rail of large icon buttons pinned top-right of the canvas. urbanflow puts its analysis tools here; Flux puts its modes (Model, HVAC, Weather, Runs, Results, Files), one selected at a time.

items.name: left-context-panel
items.title: Left Context Panel
items.description: Shell Left Context Panel: the AppShell's left panel. product="urbanflow" (252px: page switcher menu, optional tabs, scrolling Building / Floor / Zone sections) or product="flux" (360px: children fill the panel, e.g. the chat). Inside AppShell it fills the width the shell gives it (resizable, collapsible); on its own it uses its default width.
